Sentence (English): It has been a while since installation, and I can see why it is so highly recommended for newlyweds and households of one or two people.
Comments (English): It has been a while since installation, and I can see why it is so highly recommended for newlyweds and households of one or two people. I chose the countertop 6-place setting model because a built-in dishwasher was too bulky due to kitchen space constraints. It offers better storage than I expected and holds a considerable amount of dishes. For two people, we were able to easily wash a day's worth of dishes in a single wash. Most of all, I am most satisfied with how much dishwashing time has been reduced. Even greasy dishes and pots are cleaned surprisingly well, and I was pleased that glass cups and cutlery do not leave many water stains. The automatic door-opening drying function makes managing internal humidity after washing quite convenient. The beige color looks clean and luxurious in person, so it blends well with kitchen decor. It has a unique Bespoke aesthetic rather than the feel of a standard appliance, making the kitchen look much more organized. The noise level is not as high as I expected, so it wasn't bothersome even when running it in the evening or at night, and since the controls are intuitive, my parents were able to use it quickly as well. Sentence (English): I was quite worried since this was my first time using a dishwasher, but now that I’ve actually used it, I love it.
Comments (English): I was quite worried since this was my first time using a dishwasher, but now that I’ve actually used it, I love it. It used to take 30 minutes to an hour to wash dishes after a family of four dinner, but that time has been reduced, and I feel much more at ease. Even when we had a housewarming party after moving and had a lot of guests, I didn't worry at all because I had the LG dishwasher. I usually run it on automatic mode, but if I feel uneasy after eating greasy food or on a rainy day, I switch to steam mode. The dishes come out squeaky clean, and I feel much more at ease than when washing them by hand. I chose the LG dishwasher specifically for the steam function, and every time I run the steam mode, I think I made the right choice. I chose the built-in model, and I really love how it keeps the kitchen neatly organized.

The Benchmark top of the line went on sale and I bought one. The build quality and cleaning capabilities are great. The quiet operation? Not so much. In fact it feels like the old Whirlpool was quieter. My Apple Watch measured about 51 dB at the front of the Whirlpool while operating. It reads about 49-50 dB in front of the newly installed Bosch. The unit supposedly is rated at 39 dB, but this rating must be at a distance of 30 feet or something. If you think you're getting a very quiet dishwasher for the premium price, you'll be disappointed. That's what I thought I would get in the Benchmark and I am completely disappointed! If I ever buy another dishwasher, I might still buy a Bosch, but I'll go for a much cheaper mid tier unit.

Sentence (English): When we moved, I bought all LG appliances, and I repeatedly convinced my husband that I absolutely had to buy a dishwasher and a robot vacuum.
Comments (English): When we moved, I bought all LG appliances, and I repeatedly convinced my husband that I absolutely had to buy a dishwasher and a robot vacuum. I felt that a model with a hot air drying function was essential. One downside is that it's dark inside without a light, so I think it would be nice to have one. You should allow at least two hours for the dishwashing cycle, including drying. Honestly, I don't find myself running the dishwasher every single day. Comments (English): [ Quality of Life Home Appliances ] || ---------------- || Now that I'm raising a child, I truly understand why everyone calls a dishwasher a "quality of life" appliance. But since getting this product, my stress from housework has drastically decreased. At first, I wondered if hand washing wasn't faster, but after actually using it, I am so satisfied just knowing that my wrists and back hurt less. I used to sigh as soon as I saw the pile of dishes after putting the kids to sleep, but now that I can just throw them in and run it, my evenings have become much more relaxed. I think any household with young children will relate to this. The cleaning power was also better than expected. It washes greasy dishes and pots perfectly, and leaves almost no water stains, so I never have to do the dishes again. It makes me feel good, especially whenever I see the glass cups and stainless steel dishes coming out sparkling clean. Perhaps because it is a 14-place setting, it holds a lot more than I thought. Even if I put the kids' dishes and adult dishes in separately, there is still plenty of room, so it is great for running a whole day's worth at once. Since it's built-in, the kitchen looks much cleaner, and I liked that the Objet Collection design itself is sophisticated rather than flashy, so it doesn't detract from the interior. But best of all is that the pressure to do the dishes has been reduced. While raising children, even a brief moment of rest is truly precious, and I am very satisfied because it feels like this unit creates that time for me. I don't think I could go back to living without it now.

But best of all is that the pressure to do the dishes has been reduced. While raising children, even a brief moment of rest is truly precious, and I am very satisfied because it feels like this unit creates that time for me. I don't think I could go back to living without it now.

I am satisfied with the large 12-place setting capacity and cleaning power. ] || ---------------- || I finally took the plunge and bought a My Dear 12-place setting dishwasher to escape the stress of washing dishes, and to start with, I am so satisfied that I wish I had bought it sooner. Since it was a home installation, the technician came in person and neatly handled the water supply and drainage connections, so I didn't have to worry about anything. The silver color looks clean and luxurious in the kitchen, fitting perfectly. I'll include a photo of the installed unit. What I'm most satisfied with is definitely the capacity. Being a 12-place setting, it fits a day's worth of dishes for a family of four, as well as pots, pans, and large plates all at once. It is incredibly convenient to be able to run a full wash cycle even when guests come over and a huge pile of dishes accumulates. The inner shelves are height-adjustable, making it great for maximizing space when loading large dishes. The cleaning power is also better than expected. Honestly, I doubted whether a dishwasher could properly remove grease or burnt-on food, but I was surprised that the dishes came out cleaner than hand washing when I ran the powerful cycle. The high-temperature sterilization wash provides peace of mind regarding hygiene, and once drying is complete, the dishes come out fluffy, so there is no need to wipe them with a dishcloth. I've included a before-and-after comparison photo as well. I also like that there are various cycles available. I can choose the right setting for the situation, such as Powerful, Standard, Eco, and Quick. I use the Quick cycle to quickly clean simple items and the Powerful cycle to thoroughly wash greasy ones. The Eco mode saves water and electricity, so I use it often, and the cleaning power is sufficient. It also has a reservation function, so it is convenient to set it before bed and have clean dishes ready in the morning. The noise level is quieter than I expected, so it isn't too bothersome even when I do other things while it's running, and I don't feel burdened even when using the timer at night. Most of all, I am most satisfied that the time I used to spend on dishwashing every day has been drastically reduced, allowing me to use that time for other tasks. I hesitated a lot about the price, but considering the capacity, cleaning power, and convenience, it is definitely worth the price. I confidently recommend this to first-time dishwashers or to those looking for a large capacity for a large family. Thank you for making such a great product, and I will use it well for a long time!

Comments (English): [ Overall, a decent dishwasher lady with high satisfaction. ] || ---------------- || I am currently using a Samsung 6-place freestanding model, but I had a 12-place built-in model installed at my mom's house. First off, my mom has back pain, so I really agonized over choosing a built-in model where she would have to bend over. However, since the advantage of taking up less space is significant, I just went for it! I also debated between the 14-place and 12-place models, but since we are a household of three, I thought the smaller 12-place model would be more useful, so I chose that one. Actually, the most difficult part was choosing the brand. Maybe it's because of my poor research skills, but LG only came in beige. I preferred the clean look of white, so I chose Samsung. Just the technician who installed it mentioned that the energy efficiency rating does decrease when using the drying function. Still, seeing the 12-place setting after looking at the 6-place one, I like that the storage space is so big that I don't have to worry about Tetris anymore! When using the 6-place setting, I actually found it more comfortable to wash large pots by hand; the moment a big pot fits in, I have to activate my Tetris skills. If you own your home rather than renting, I think a built-in model is definitely more convenient. The design is clean, it's energy-efficient, and I am someone who believes the dishwasher is the best appliance in human history.

I heard that LG is the best when it comes to dishwashers, so I purchased an LG model. As expected, I am very satisfied with the product. The buttons are very intuitive, and it is easy to use. I chose a model that air-dries rather than one that fully dries, and that is also very convenient. Although we are a family of four, I purchased the 14-place setting model, so we are using it comfortably with plenty of space. On days with fewer dishes, we only need to use a moderate amount of water, making it very easy to save water. When I first bought it, I wondered if it was really a necessary appliance, but now I think it would be difficult to manage without a dishwasher.
Comments (Original): [ 맞벌이 부부에게 필수템이라고 생각되는 가전제품이에요 ] || ---------------- || 맞벌이에 육아를 병행하고 있어서 설거지를 매번 하기가 조금 부담스러운 감이 있어서 이번에 큰맘 먹고 구매하게 되었습니다. 식기세척기라고 하면은 LG가 제일 좋다고 해서 LG 제품으로 구매했고요. 기대했던 만큼 제품의 사용 만족도는 굉장히 높은 편입니다. 버튼도 굉장히 직관적이고 사용이 편리한 편이에요. 완전 건조가 되는 제품을 사지 않고 자연 건조되는 제품을 구매했는데 이 역시도 굉장히 편리합니다. 4인가구지만 14인용으로 구매했기 때문에 넉넉하고 편안하게 사용하고 있어요. 설거지가 적은 날에는 상당 급수만 사용하면 돼서 물 절약도 굉장히 용이한 편입니다.처음 구매할 때만 해도 이게 과연 정말 필요한 가전제품일까 생각했는데 식기세척기가 없으면 이제는 조금 힘들 것 같아요.

Sentence (English): After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Sentence (English): Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth.
Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!
