Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Sentence (English): As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced.
Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ No. 1 Dishwasher Purchase, Samsung Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || I purchased a dishwasher. When making the purchase, my most important criteria were a large 14-place setting capacity and a hot air drying function. After comparing various products, I chose a Samsung dishwasher. I was also satisfied that Rocket Installation was available, allowing me to receive delivery on my desired date. Since scheduling was easy, preparing for the installation was smooth. Before installation, a renovation technician visited first to confirm the placement of the dishwasher and neatly modified the side of the sink and the baseboard to fit the dishwasher's size. The work took about an hour, and since the work involves cutting, the noise is quite loud; it would be good to keep this in mind if you live in an apartment or multi-unit dwelling. The cost was an additional 90,000 won, and card payment was accepted. (The estimate may vary depending on the sink structure and size.) Afterward, the technician visited at the agreed time to install the dishwasher. He spent about 30 minutes meticulously installing it and kindly explained how to use it. He mentioned that nowadays, for environmental reasons, instructions are provided via QR code instead of booklets, and he left a piece of paper with simple product information and the QR code. I am truly satisfied with the hot air drying function, which was the most important feature for me. Since it dries thoroughly, I can organize dishes immediately after washing without having to wait for them to dry, making things much more convenient. When I first used it, I noticed a slightly fishy smell, but after adding about half a bowl of vinegar and a spoonful of citric acid to the bottom and running it once, the odor almost completely disappeared. I have been using it for about three months now and am satisfied with it, as there are no particular odors. Initially, I only used an all-in-one detergent, but I felt some limescale remained, so I purchased fabric softener separately to use with it. Using the softener definitely left even the glass cups and stainless steel parts much cleaner and clearer, which I was very satisfied with. Since it is a 14-place setting, the capacity is quite generous. I can fit pots and large plates in one go without any difficulty, and there is plenty of space even after putting in dishes, so it was great to be able to use it without worry even when guests come over or on days with a lot of dishes. You can adjust the height by pressing the blue lever next to the middle compartment, so you can use it comfortably according to the size of the dishes you put in. I was also satisfied with the freedom to utilize space, as the internal dividers can be laid flat or stood up as desired. Thanks to this, I was able to efficiently arrange everything from pots and large bowls to small dishes according to the situation, making it very convenient to use. Since it is white, the overall atmosphere of the kitchen looks much cleaner and brighter after installation, so I am satisfied with the interior design aspect as well. After trying out various functions, I find myself using the AI feature most frequently by setting it to include an extra rinse and hot air drying options. It is incredibly convenient because it automatically detects the level of dirt and adjusts the cycle accordingly, so I don't have to worry too much; I just need to put the items in and run it. It also supports app connectivity, allowing me to receive instant notifications when the wash cycle is finished. It works well with both Samsung phones and iPhones, making it very convenient to use. However, the cutlery compartment requires inserting cutlery one by one, which felt a bit cumbersome at first. So, I only put tongs and long cooking utensils in the standard compartment, and I purchased a dedicated dishwasher cutlery holder from Coupang to store everything at once. After using it overall, I understand why dishwashers are referred to as "quality-of-life appliances." As dishwashing time has decreased, I am definitely less stressed, and the burden of daily housework has been significantly reduced. After using it myself, I was very satisfied with this appliance, and so far, I have been using it happily without any particular downsides. I would like to recommend this to anyone considering buying a dishwasher!

Sentence (English): I, too, used to put off washing dishes, so I never finished my day neatly, and I felt like that fatigue carried over into the next day.
Comments (English): [ I hope my review will be helpful to those of you considering buying a dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || I, too, used to put off washing dishes, so I never finished my day neatly, and I felt like that fatigue carried over into the next day. I chose this product because I wanted to change this lifestyle pattern. In particular, I worried a lot about whether the 6-place setting was suitable for a family of four. Ultimately, it was the perfect choice for our home. Since I could use it without any burden after every meal, it actually proved to be very useful. As the time spent on washing dishes decreased, my evenings became much more relaxed, and naturally, the quality of my rest improved as well. It was impressive how simply adding a single appliance raised my overall satisfaction with my life. I also liked that the noise level is low, so there are no restrictions on usage time. I hope my review will be helpful to those considering purchasing a dishwasher.
Comments (Original): [ 식기세척기를 고민 중이신 분들께 제 후기가 참고되시길 ] || ---------------- || 저 역시 설거지를 미루다 보니 하루의 마무리가 늘 깔끔하지 않았고, 그 피로가 다음 날까지 이어지는 느낌이 들었습니다. 이런 생활 패턴을 바꿔보고 싶어 선택한 제품입니다.특히 4인 가족 기준으로 6인용이 적당한지에 대해 많이 고민했습니다. 결론적으로는 저희 집에는 딱 맞는 선택이었습니다. 매 끼니 후 부담 없이 사용할 수 있어 오히려 활용도가 높았습니다.설거지에 쓰이던 시간이 줄어드니 저녁 시간이 훨씬 여유로워졌고, 자연스럽게 휴식의 질도 좋아졌습니다. 단순히 가전 하나를 들였을 뿐인데 생활 전반의 만족도가 올라갔다는 점이 인상적이었습니다.소음이 크지 않아 사용 시간에 제약이 없다는 점도 마음에 들었습니다.식기세척기를 고민 중이신 분들께 제 후기가 참고가 되었으면 합니다.

Sentence (English): This is a review of a product I bought with my own money.
Comments (English): [ Why did I buy it now? ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. As a newlywed couple of two, I really agonized over whether to buy this or not. I thought hand washing would be sufficient. I was planning to get a large-capacity built-in model to install in the base cabinet if I was going to buy one anyway. However, no matter how much I thought about it, the capacity seemed excessive, and I felt like detergent and water would be wasted. Plus, I hated the idea of bending over. So, I chose it, even if it meant putting up with the downside of it taking up space! First off, I am extremely satisfied with my choice. As you can see in the photos, it does take up a bit of space, but the design is clean, so it doesn't really stand out. Also, since I place it right next to the sink, I can move dishes immediately. That is a huge advantage! I don't need to bend over and spill water everywhere! And for a two-person household, there is actually always space left over. Here's a money-saving tip: even if you split a bar of detergent in half, the dishes still come out incredibly clean! The performance is top-notch >_<. There is a strainer at the bottom of the dishwasher. In my case, perhaps because I give heavily greased dishes a quick rinse in water before putting them in, It has been over a month since I bought it, and I haven't once had to take it apart to empty it. There is absolutely no residue left behind. I used to add rinse aid at first, but I stopped at some point, and there is hardly any difference; everything always comes out squeaky clean. Anyway, even though we are a two-person household, I don't even have to do the simple task of washing dishes. Since the dishwasher lady does everything for me, I have more time to watch TV. It feels like heaven to run a hot water wash without sweating profusely in the heat. The noise isn't as loud as I expected, so it is totally possible to run it before bed and sleep. Don't hesitate. Once you use it, you will wonder why you didn't buy it sooner. It is seriously much more convenient than the base cabinet dishwasher I used at my parents' house. I want to buy one for my parents' house too. ] || ---------------- || As a family of four, our kitchen sink tends to fill up quickly after just three meals a day. Especially after dinner, frying pans, pots, soup bowls, and the kids' plates pile up all at once, making dishwashing a surprisingly big chore. In fact, a dishwasher was an appliance I had been considering for the past three years. Although people around me said that once you use one, you can't go back to using it, I hesitated when it came time to actually buy one myself. I also had the preconceived notion that dishes need to be washed by hand to be clean. The biggest reason I chose this product was the freedom of installation. Our kitchen has a layout that makes built-in installation difficult, so a countertop type was essential. Since it sits right on top of the sink, I can use it immediately as long as the space fits, and I liked the fact that there would be no burden even if I rearranged the layout or moved later. Many people are likely debating between the 6-person and 12-person models, but if you usually dine with around four people, I believe the 6-person model will be more than satisfactory. After actually using it, I found it highly versatile because I didn't have to fill it up completely for every meal; in fact, I could run it without any pressure. This was a realistic choice for a family of four. I am so satisfied with it now that I regret the time I spent hesitating at first. If dishwashing has been a stress for you, I think it is worth seriously considering. I am very satisfied. I will continue to use it and definitely write a review after a month.

I know the Bosch and KitchenAid names get thrown around constantly and are highly recommended, but I personally don't like the rack layouts in Bosch models, and I'm not a fan of exposed heating elements in KitchenAids. I've always been nervous one rogue piece of plastic would take a dive onto the heating element and fumigate the whole kitchen. Years ago, when I started buying appliances for my home, I tried to stick with the idea that “buying American-made is best.” Unfortunately, my experiences didn't exactly support that theory. I had a Frigidaire dishwasher that seemed philosophically opposed to drying dishes, and a GE dishwasher that stopped heating water in less than two years. That GE lasted about as long as my Maytag washer that somehow thought a full load of clothes only needed four inches of water to wash and also never once found its center of gravity. Because of all that, I eventually decided to try LG. Starting in 2019, I began replacing my appliances with LG products, and honestly, they've been excellent for me. My LG range, washer, and dryer are all aging gracefully, have never needed service, and still work exactly like they did the day I bought them. So going with an LG dishwasher made sense. This dishwasher was made in Korea, and based on my experiences so far, I'm perfectly content with that. Although I will say LG is building more appliances in the U.S. now, if that's what you're looking for. First impressions of this dishwasher were very positive. It feels sturdy out of the box, and I really like the modern square towel-bar handle design. I will mention that this particular model does NOT include the LED tub light or metal wash arms depicted in some of the photos on the Lowe's website. That's more of a Lowe's photo issue than an LG issue, though, and I don't blame the dishwasher itself for that. It didn't sneak onto the website and upload the wrong glamour shots of itself. After using it for a while, everything I've thrown its way to be washed has come out spotless. Drying performance has also been surprisingly good, especially considering there's no exposed heating element. I do use rinse aid. Like most dishwashers, plastics with indentions may still need to be tipped slightly to fully dry, but I've yet to meet a dishwasher that has fully solved the mystery of wet Tupperware lids. The rack layout took a little getting used to. The tines on the bottom rack are spaced differently than what I've been used to on previous dishwashers, and they do not run completely across the very front or through the middle section of the lower rack. I do think the rack could have been designed a little better in those areas because it would make loading pans and casserole dishes easier. That said, the lower rack still handles most pans just fine, and it even accommodates my air fryer insert with no problem. The rack layout is starting to grow on me.Speaking of, the middle rack adjusts to three positions, which I appreciate, and I've had no issues fitting tumblers, salad plates, or mixing bowls. I actually removed the silverware basket completely and only use the third rack for silverware and utensils, all of which have come out perfectly clean.The LG ThinQ app is also very user-friendly. I like the downloadable cycles feature, and the dishwasher can store three downloaded cycles at a time. You can also customize button sounds, end chimes, and several other settings directly through the app, which honestly appeals to the same part of my brain that used to customize ringtones in 2004.Now for the honest part: this dishwasher is louder than I expected. I'm honestly not sure where the decibel rating comes from because the motor itself is NOT loud. In fact, the motor and drain pump are impressively quiet. What you mainly hear is water splashing around inside the tub while spraying, especially near the top of the door. The door itself gets warm, which makes me think additional insulation or sound dampening could have helped.The wash arms alternate during cycles, and you can actually hear the sound change as water shifts to different spray zones. Oddly enough, the fuller the dishwasher is, the quieter it seems to be. For me, this isn't a deal breaker because of my kitchen layout, and honestly, hearing the strong spray action is somewhat reassuring. But if you have an open-concept kitchen or enjoy having calm conversations in the kitchen, this thing occasionally sounds like somebody pressure washing a kayak indoors. I'd still stick with LG, but you might move up to a higher model if it being quieter is worth the extra money.I will say this machine definitely has a few quirks. During the sensing phase, it starts and stops several times and begins with a softer spray before ramping up. The first time it did it, I was concerned about the variations in spray pressure, but it urns out that's just how it operates.The drain pump is one of the quietest I've ever heard, which I appreciate because I absolutely hate loud pumps that sit there growling while sucking air for no reason like they're trying to drain an Olympic swimming pool through a coffee straw. LG's inverter pumps continue to impress me, just as it does on my front load washer. Go LG! Another quirky thing is that the drain pump drains in pulses. It briefly drains, circulates water again, then pulses a few more times. It's unusual, but I'm sure an engineer somewhere has a perfectly good reason for this and it drains quickly and quietly.The auto-open door feature is also nice, but there's one thing buyers should know: the Dynamic Dry system continues running the heater and fan while the door is open, so warm air blows into the kitchen for around 15 minutes afterward. Depending on your kitchen setup, that may or may not matter to you. If your kitchen already feels like the summers in the South, you may notice it more.Overall, I'm very impressed with this dishwasher and would absolutely buy it again. Like most modern appliances, it has a few quirks, but the cleaning performance, drying results, build quality, and quiet motor system outweigh the negatives for me.Pros:• Excellent cleaning performance• Very good drying results without exposed heating element• Quiet motor and drain pump• Adjustable middle rack• Third rack works great for utensils and silverware• Strong spray pressure• ThinQ app is easy to use• Downloadable/customizable cycles• Modern appearance and sturdy feelCons:• Louder water splashing noise than expected• Door gets warm during operation• No LED tub light on this model• Rack tine layout could be better for pans and casserole dishes• Warm air vents into kitchen during Dynamic Dry with auto-open featureQuirks:• Wash arms alternate and noticeably change sound during cycles• Drain pump drains in pulses instead of one continuous drain• Dishwasher seems quieter when fully loaded• Sensing cycle starts and stops several times before ramping up• Plastics still need occasional tipping for perfect dryingAll in all, I like it, and it's another great LG product!

The tines on the bottom rack are spaced differently than what I've been used to on previous dishwashers, and they do not run completely across the very front or through the middle section of the lower rack. I do think the rack could have been designed a little better in those areas because it would make loading pans and casserole dishes easier. What you mainly hear is water splashing around inside the tub while spraying, especially near the top of the door. May 18, 2026: A technician visited to take action, but despite rust being visible in multiple areas, they only replaced the hinges and left, so I submitted a customer inquiry. 3. May 20, 2026: Received a call from the Pohang Service Center, and a senior technician revisited and acknowledged that rust had formed on the product's frame. 4. May 21, 2026: They stated that replacing this part is difficult and that either rust removal followed by coating or a refund are possible. However, regarding the refund, they explained that since the dishwasher is considered to have a full 7-year lifespan, depreciation based on the time elapsed so far would be reflected, estimating the total at approximately 20% at an annual rate of about 10%. Since LG dishwashers are designed to be used with salt, rust formation is clearly a defect, and even with rust removal, complete removal is difficult; therefore, I requested a refund and inquired about the amount. I also explained why depreciation is being applied when I am not at fault in any way, but they stated it was beyond their authority. They promised to look into the refund price and contact me. 5. 260527 Upon inquiry, I was told that a 40% depreciation rate must be applied, but the exact amount has not yet been calculated. When I asked why it was 40%, they explained that the usage cycle for a dishwasher is 5 years. I do not understand why they are applying a 40% depreciation rate after using it for just over a year and a half when it is not the consumer's fault; however, I requested again that they look into the refund amount (a week has passed, but they still say they do not know). This is my second LG dishwasher. I couldn't take my first one with me because I gave the built-in dishwasher to the buyer during a move, but I used it very well, and there was no rust. My current second purchase is a model that has improved by several years, but rust has appeared after more than a year. A dishwasher is an appliance that is constantly exposed to water. Rust is unacceptable. Of course, product defects can occur. But why are they shifting the burden of those defects onto the consumer in the form of depreciation? I request appropriate action. Sentence (English): I chose the 14-place setting size without much hesitation because it fits perfectly into the dishwasher cabinet in my new apartment.
Comments (English): [ Be careful in homes with babies, as there is no lock, so it might just open while in operation. ] || ---------------- || I chose the 14-place setting size without much hesitation because it fits perfectly into the dishwasher cabinet in my new apartment. I really agonized over choosing between Samsung and LG. I decided on Samsung because it has a prettier design and is convenient to control via phone since it connects with the SmartThings app. Above all, since the functions of Samsung and LG as dishwashers are almost identical, there isn't much difference. The only difference is the exterior. Secondly, regarding limescale management, LG requires adding 1kg of salt every six months, whereas Samsung uses a filter. I chose LG because I liked the salt-based limescale management feature. ^^ Since there is a dishwasher cabinet, the installation was neat, and using it is very convenient. A major advantage of this product is that you can open the door to add dishes while it is running. However, if I had to point out a downside for a household with a baby, it is that the door opens if you grab and pull the handle while it is operating. Sentence (English): I pre-wash the dishes with just water before putting them in.
Comments (English): I pre-wash the dishes with just water before putting them in. First off, there are naturally no food residues, so there are no major issues. Also, perhaps because I used hot water, it works well even without detergent, so I have left the detergent I bought unused. Comments (English): [ A great disappointment so far ] || ---------------- || Costco should consider offering and recommending other appliance brands that care more about their customers and provide better warranty support and service experiences. We purchased this Bosch dishwasher from Costco based on Bosch's reputation for premium quality and reliability, but unfortunately our experience has been extremely disappointing. The dishwasher failed completely after a relatively short period of use. It froze with all indicator lights illuminated and would not restart or function at all. Since 4/29, our household of six has been without a working dishwasher. The biggest frustration has been the warranty repair process. Service appointments were only available on Wednesdays, which created long delays. After finally getting a technician visit on 5/13, we were told multiple parts needed replacement and at least one critical part was on backorder for weeks. We were initially told mid-June with no definite ETA. Communication and transparency from Bosch have also been poor. We were not provided a written diagnosis or exact part numbers, and when I offered to purchase the parts myself to speed up the repair, Bosch would not support or reimburse that effort. As of now, the earliest repair appointment is scheduled for 6/3 — more than five weeks after the dishwasher initially failed. That is simply not an acceptable repair timeline for a premium appliance under warranty. While Costco itself has always been excellent, this experience with Bosch service, parts availability, and scheduling has seriously damaged my confidence in the brand. I expected far better reliability and customer support from a premium appliance manufacturer.

Sentence (English): As a software developer I have been appalled at how Bosch software engineers gated features and made an entirely horrible user interface experience.
Comments (English): [ Super bad feature gating and poor user interface ] || ---------------- || As a software developer I have been appalled at how Bosch software engineers gated features and made an entirely horrible user interface experience. In 2026 it should be table stakes to connect an appliance to wifi and control with a smart phone app. Oh boy does this one have an app, but it's terrible. In their attempt to be smart with their smart phone app they made some of the worse choices. Choices that worsen the actual dishwasher experience. * Delay start cannot be chosen from the dishwasher buttons. That feature moved to the smartphone app. * To use the smartphone app, you have to remember (each run) to put the dishwasher in "remote start" mode so you can control it from the app. This negates the best reason to have a smart phone app, which in my opinion is to be able to control the dishwasher after you've forgotten. (I NEVER plan ahead to sit down, open my phone, and run my dishwasher for leisure. NEVER) * The smartphone app heats up my phone and burns through many percentages of battery life in just a few minutes. * The vast majority of the customizing takes more effort than you want to spend, which means you won't do it. No modes are quick to select. No features are quick to pick. It's confusing to say the least and when you think you have it figured out there's a high chance it won't run because feedback is vague at best. * You have to wait for the app to connect to the dishwasher before you can do anything. It takes too long. * Want to look at the model or serial number? Wait. It takes too long because you have to connect over wifi/internet. If I were on the software team I'd get a firmware update ready ASAP that did this: * Put delay back on the dishwasher UI. Press and hold one of the buttons to bring up delay on the screen and press again to increment hours up or something. * Make remote control work. always. Not when I rememeber I want remote control. * Fix that darn smart phone app so it doesn't turn my phone into a hot coal burning my fingers. * Save dishwasher specs in the app for quick access. Make control commands accessible right away. And queue the commands in the background. Notify the user if they don't go through. That way a human can do the needful and move on. Just make it reliable for cripes sake. I could go on but my dishwasher just connected and I'm ready to wash dishes.

Sentence (English): Title: Escape the Dishwashing Hell!
Comments (English): Title: Escape the Dishwashing Hell! I am so satisfied that I wonder why I didn't buy this sooner. It is true that this appliance improves quality of life second only to a dryer. We are a family of three, and running a full wash cycle after dinner fits perfectly. Even greasy pork belly grills or rice bowls stuck with hardened rice grains come out sparkling clean after just a quick rinse with water. I feel especially relieved knowing that the 100% Steam function allows me to sterilize and disinfect baby dishes and tumblers all at once. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically pops open to release the remaining heat and steam, so there is no odor and drying is excellent. It is also quiet enough that you wouldn't even notice if you left it running at night while you sleep. Hesitation only delays the installation!
Comments (Original): 제목: 설거지 지옥 탈출! 왜 이제 샀나 싶을 정도로 대만족합니다⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐가전 중에 건조기 다음으로 삶의 질을 높여준다는 말이 진짜네요. 3인 가족인데 저녁 먹고 한 번에 몰아서 돌리면 딱 맞습니다.기름때 묻은 삼겹살 불판이나 굳어버린 밥풀 묻은 밥공기도 애벌설거지 대충 물로만 헹궈서 넣어도 번쩍번쩍하게 닦여서 나옵니다. 특히 100℃ 스팀 기능 덕분에 유아식기나 텀블러 살균 소독까지 한 번에 끝낼 수 있어서 안심이에요.세척이 다 끝나면 알아서 문이 툭 열리면서 내부에 남아있는 열기와 수증기를 날려주니까 냄새도 안 나고 건조도 아주 잘 됩니다. 소음도 밤에 돌려놓고 자도 모를 정도로 조용해요. 고민은 설치만 늦출 뿐입니다!

Sentence (English): I was hesitant about purchasing a Maytag dishwasher after the previous Maytag resulted in a $434 repair bill 18 months ago (after being in service for 2 years).
Comments (English): [ Does the job, not as quiet as other Maytags ] || ---------------- || I was hesitant about purchasing a Maytag dishwasher after the previous Maytag resulted in a $434 repair bill 18 months ago (after being in service for 2 years). When it started acting erratic and then would not start a month ago, i went in search of a replacement. This unit has been in service for a month. It is used about twice a week, sometimes 3 times a week. A month is not long enough to determine the long term viability of a dishwasher. So far i have found that the machine is a bit louder than I expected, although not objectionably loud-you definitely know which cycle the machine is in, you can carry on a quiet conversation without the dishwasher interrupting. The upper basket is designed for taller items to fit, but i have found the tine placement does not allow me to place as many smaller items as the old Maytag. A month is also not long enough to check how well the dual filtration system holds up-at this point I have not had to clean the solid food containment basket and the dishes (including wine glasses) have come out clean. I do use a rinse aid product to avoid spotting on glassware. I wish these surveys allowed a one year follow up response which would give a better perspective on the dishwasher. Thus far it is doing the job. If you want a quiet machine that you can hardly tell if it is operating, look at other machines with better db ratings.

Comments (English): [ Persistent Chemical Odor During Normal Operation ] || ---------------- || I purchased the LG LDTS5552S dishwasher and have experienced a persistent chemical odor since the beginning of ownership.The smell is difficult to describe precisely, but it resembles heated rubber, vinyl, petroleum products, or synthetic plastic. The odor becomes stronger as the dishwasher heats up and appears to be emitted from the lower vent area.The problem occurs even during normal operation without using the High Temp or Extra Dry settings.Over the past year I have tried numerous troubleshooting steps, including cleaning the filters repeatedly, running cycles without detergent, using dishwasher cleaning cycles, and removing additional plastic accessories from inside the machine. None of these actions resolved the issue.The dishes themselves do not retain the odor, but the heated air emitted by the dishwasher does. The smell is strong enough to travel beyond the kitchen and can sometimes be noticed on the second floor of the house.After more than a year of trying to live with this issue, I have stopped using the dishwasher altogether and returned to washing dishes by hand because I am not comfortable having my family continuously exposed to the odor.What concerns me most is that this odor appears whenever the appliance is heated, suggesting that materials inside the unit may be releasing volatile compounds into the air. I do not know whether LG has evaluated the long-term impact of breathing these emissions during routine daily use, but I believe this is a legitimate concern that deserves attention.I am disappointed because otherwise the dishwasher performs well. If LG is aware of this issue or has a solution, I would genuinely appreciate a response. I hope my review helps other consumers, especially those who are sensitive to chemical odors, make a more informed purchasing decision.

The most satisfying aspect was its cleaning power. In particular, LG’s TrueSteam feature was impressive for helping to reduce water stains and odors. The LG dishwasher also offers decent space utilization. Since the shelves can be adjusted according to the height and shape of the dishes, it was convenient to load pots and large plates, and it was more than sufficient for family use. Using the top shelf also allowed for efficient organization of cups and cooking utensils. I was also satisfied with the noise level. It is quiet enough that I forget it is running, so running it at night was not a significant concern. I felt it was relatively comfortable to use even in an open-plan kitchen. The design is also clean. The recent Objet Collection line blends well with kitchen furniture, making it easy to create a built-in look. I had the impression that it was a product designed to harmonize with the interior rather than just feeling like a simple home appliance.

Given the longevity of Whirlpool appliances, I'm staying with them!

Sentence (English): When installing a built-in dishwasher, the sink must be secured with wooden supports before installation.
Comments (English): [ LG Electronics, worst service ] || ---------------- || When installing a built-in dishwasher, the sink must be secured with wooden supports before installation. I ordered this product and was told the installation was complete. However, when I tried to install the water purifier on the sink above the dishwasher three days later, I was told that the sink was wobbling up and down, suggesting that the structure was not reinforced during the dishwasher installation. I called the LG Electronics installer, and he admitted that only one of the two wooden supports was secured, with the other simply leaning against the wall. (Please refer to the attached video.) I was dumbfounded and asked for it to be reinforced again, but they told me I had to pay another 103,000 won and that it wouldn't be possible for another week. Left with no choice, I hired a private contractor to perform the reinforcement work separately for 100,000 won. When I called the LG Electronics Customer Center to request a refund, they said they could not return it. Is simply securing the existing wood to the wall a paid service that requires a 100,000 won fee during dishwasher installation? If so, please add 100,000 won to the price of the dishwasher and list it again. I request that Coupang also add 100,000 won to the price of this product. Please do not use LG Electronics at all for providing such absurd service.

Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Sentence (English): Freedom from dishwashing.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.
