Sentence (English): However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): It is simply wonderful in many ways.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.
Comments (English): 1. Freedom from dishwashing. The mere existence of dishwashing always felt like a chore. Even when I cooked a meal, the thought that every dish used would become a chore made me lose the desire to eat. The arguments, big and small, between family members over dishwashing were also a source of stress. I deliberated for a long time before ordering, and although it has only been a few days since the dishwasher arrived, I am incredibly happy to feel completely free from the dishwashing that always bothered me and was a burden. Pre-washing dishes in water and stacking them inside like a puzzle is truly nothing. Since the dishwasher takes care of the task just by putting them in, I could actually find some enjoyment in it. While loading the dishes requires a bit of knack and I wish there were a little more guidance on that, I am fully satisfied. Even greasy side dish bowls that aren't removed by pre-washing, food scraps like eggs on plates, and rice bowls stuck with grains are all cleaned using only the standard settings. If it bothers me, I can simply add an extra rinse cycle. It is convenient because I no longer have to worry about the hot water and gas costs used for grease removal, or the water wasted from rinsing multiple times out of a sense of unease; the dishwasher uses water efficiently to wash dishes. 2. Regarding Installation. The date was slightly delayed due to an installation issue, but I appreciated that they adjusted the schedule with such attention to detail. The installation technician was also kind. Seeing the dishwasher in person, I was a bit surprised by how much larger it was than I expected, but I liked that it holds a lot of dishes and is practical. However, it does take up a significant amount of kitchen space, so it is advisable to consider the size before ordering. It seems there is a policy prohibiting installation in homes using groundwater. However, simply installing a small water softening filter in the kitchen solves the problem, so it is not an issue. As long as you have the filter ready, the technician will take care of the installation. I was initially surprised and sad to be informed that installation was not possible, and I wondered if I should give up on the dishwasher, but it turned out to be just a minor misunderstanding. 3. Hot Air Drying vs. Powerful Drying? I really agonized over choosing between the Hot Air Dry and Power Dry models. After looking at reviews for the Hot Air Dry model, I found many comments saying that this feature isn't used as often as expected. Also, considering the additional costs associated with hot air, such as electricity bills and drying time, I decided on the Power Dry model. However, after actually using the dishwasher, I realized that I don't even need the Power Dry function on a daily basis. The key feature was the automatic door opening. The washing process is already running at high temperature, and once it finishes, the automatic door opening circulates the heat, so most items are dry by the time it finishes. For areas where water has pooled, such as bowls with hollow bottoms or the bottoms of cups, you can simply open the door when it opens to drain the water and return the items to their original state. Based on the reviews I read, using the Hot Air Dry function seems to have the advantage of giving a feeling of better sanitization, and the dishes feel warm and fluffy after drying. However, if you are only thinking about general dishwashing, I don't think choosing the Power Dry model would make any difference. 4. Final Review. The dishwasher just finished all the dishes again. Since the burden of doing dishes—which felt like an immediate hassle but eventually became a chore—has completely disappeared, I have significantly reduced stress and saved both time and water. It is simply wonderful in many ways. Because my kitchen wasn't very spacious, I am still drawn to large dishwashers, but I do not want to go back to the old days of constantly doing dishes in a large kitchen. If you feel psychologically burdened by dishwashing, I highly recommend ordering one without hesitation.

Sentence (English): I finally got a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Long live the dishwasher lady! ] || ---------------- || I finally got a dishwasher. I find myself running it 2 to 3 times a day without fail. As expected, the dishwasher is more helpful than a dryer. I was planning to get a 14-place setting built-in model, but couldn't install it due to location issues, so I ordered a 6-place setting countertop instead. Although there was a slight drawback regarding scheduling with the Samsung delivery and installation technicians, I am highly satisfied with the dishwasher itself. It roughly fits the amount of dishes from a single meal for a family of four, but for items like 2-liter water bottles, bulky pots, and frying pans, I have to either wash them by hand or run the dishwasher in two batches. However, since a full wash that used to take about 30 minutes is finished in just 5 minutes for the pre-wash, it is incredibly convenient. My satisfaction level is top-notch.
Comments (Original): [ 식세기 이모님 만세!! ] || ---------------- || 드디어 식기세척기를 들였습니다.하루 2~3번 꼬박꼬박 돌리게 되네요.역시 건조기보다 더 도움되는 식세기 입니다~~식기세척기 14인용 빌트인으로 하려다가위치선정문제로 설치못하고6인용 카운터탑으로 주문했어요.삼성 배송 설치 기사분들과의 시간약속 문제로아쉬운 점은 있었으나식기세척기 자체 만족도는 높습니다.4인가족 1끼 식사에 나오는 설거지 분량은 얼추 들어가지만2리터 물병이나 부피 큰 냄비, 후라이팬 등은손으로 설거지 하던지2번 나눠서 식기세척기를 돌리든지 해야해요.하지만30분 정도 걸릴 설거지 시간이 애벌설거지 5분이면 끝나니너무 편합니다. 만족도 최상이예요.

Sentence (English): I am someone who rarely writes reviews, but I simply couldn't help but write one.
Comments (English): [ Genuinely bought with my own money: The Samsung dishwasher is the best! I love it so much! ] || ---------------- || I am someone who rarely writes reviews, but I simply couldn't help but write one. I initially purchased a 12-place setting dishwasher from Brand L, but I canceled the order after learning that I might need to raise the unit for the induction cooktop and cut out a hole for the engineered stone countertop, incurring an additional cost of between 150,000 and 200,000 won. While I was deliberating, I ended up purchasing a Samsung dishwasher. First of all, I felt confident and impressed that they sent two separate teams—one for renovation and one for installation—to visit beforehand, as it was systematic. The renovation technician was truly amazing. They worked incredibly meticulously and neatly, leaving me extremely satisfied. The installation cost was also reasonable. The renovation took about two hours, and thanks to their thoroughness, the installation technician was able to complete the setup and leave in just 30 minutes. Also, since my sink is warm white, I was worried the Samsung dishwasher might look too white. However, contrary to expectations, the Samsung color actually looked cleaner and blended in perfectly without any jarring contrast compared to the beige colors of other brands. As it is a major corporation, I had no worries about after-sales service, and the installation was flawless. It is great that it connects with Samsung SmartThings, allowing me to set my own custom wash cycles, making it very convenient to use. Also, although it lacks a water softening function, I thought it would be a hassle to add salt to a dishwasher that is meant for convenience; however, it was actually better that I only need to add detergent and rinse aid. I think choosing the Samsung dishwasher will be a decision I won't regret.

Sentence (English): It has been 5 months since I started using it.
Comments (English): It has been 5 months since I started using it. Water is leaking from the bottom of the door. I submitted a 1:1 inquiry on the Think Q app, but the response was slow. Upon checking again, I realized I have to apply for AS separately here. The app integration isn't working either. It is inconvenient. The technician visited today, but the level of service was poor. He asked to see photos of the water leak. I had attached photos when I submitted the request, but it seems he just visited without checking them. Also, when I mentioned the peeling of the protective film on the bottom of the door, he tried to gloss over it by saying there had never been such a symptom before. Sentence (English): I wanted to use a 10-place setting model that could be built into the sink, but since I have back problems and am currently in rehabilitation, I purchased a smaller 6-place setting model that sits on the countertop.
Comments (English): [ It's good. Highly recommended for people with back pain. ] || ---------------- || I wanted to use a 10-place setting model that could be built into the sink, but since I have back problems and am currently in rehabilitation, I purchased a smaller 6-place setting model that sits on the countertop. So far, I like it. I use it twice a day. It doesn't strain my back, and since it provides high-temperature sterilization, it is much cleaner than washing dishes by hand. There are many tutorials on YouTube showing how to use it. Some YouTubers stack the dishes in layers and run it. I tried that myself, but if you stack them that high, they don't clean properly. It seems the water jets from the top and bottom don't reach the dishes effectively. So, I put in a moderate amount, and it cleans really well. One inconvenience is that you have to pre-wash them properly; otherwise, things like chili powder sometimes stick to them. When dishes are stacked high, if you run the high-temperature sterilization after washing, the chili powder that wasn't removed comes out stuck right on top. I load the dishes according to the amount shown. I keep a 10L basin in the sink and collect the water coming out of the dishwasher. I pre-wash the next dishes using the water from the dishwasher. Then, when the sink is full, I put them into the dishwasher. Everything fits perfectly, and the amount is just right—not too much, not too little—and the dishes get washed well. Also, if you put stainless steel items in, the non-stainless parts turn cloudy during the high-temperature sterilization process. It's a chance to check whether the dishes I've been using are stainless steel or not! What you see in the picture is the ladle handle. I've used it for over 20 years, so it's quite worn out, but I swallowed my embarrassment and took a picture. It turns out the handle wasn't stainless steel. I found that out for the first time in 20 years. Haha. After using it a few times, you'll know the right amount of dishes. It's so intuitive to use that it hardly needs any explanation. The sterilization wash is great, but for those with back pain, washing dishes while standing still will really wreck your back. I highly recommend getting this installed right away. I regret not buying it sooner. I'm congratulating myself for using it now, even if it's late.
Comments (Original): [ 좋아요. 허리아픈 사람들에게 강추. ] || ---------------- || 싱크대 하단에 매립할수 있는 10인용정도를 사용하고 싶었지만 허리가 좋지안아 재활중이라 상단에 올려놓는 6인용 작은 용량으로 구매했어요. 일단 좋아요. 하루에 2번 사용하고 있는데. 허리에 무리가 가지 안고 고온살균까지 되니 손으로 설거지 하는 것 보다 훨씬 청결하더군요. 유튜브에서 사용방법등이 많이 소개되고 있는데요. 어떤 유투버들은 정말 겹겹이 엄청 많이 쌓아서 돌리더라고요. 저도 해봤는데 그렇게 많이 쌓아서 돌리면 제대로 안닦이더라고요. 위.아래에서 물줄기가 제대로 들어가지질 안는것 같아요ㅡ 그래서 적당히 넣어서 사용하니 정말 깨끗합니다. 또 한가지 불편한점은 애벌세척을 제대로 해줘야해요ㅡ 그렇지 안으면 간혹 고춧가루같은 그런것들이 붙어있는 경우도 있어요. 그릇들이 겹겹이 많이 쌓였을경우에는 설거지 세척 후 고온살균을 하니 제거가 안된 고춧가루가 딱 달라붙어서 나오더라고요. ㅎㅎㅎㅎ저는 그릇양을 여기에 맞춰 넣습니다. 싱크대에 설거지통 10L짜리를 놔두고 식기세척기에서 나오는 물을 받아둡니다. 식세기에서 나온 물로 다음 그릇들 애벌 세척함니다. 그리고 그 설거지통에 그릇이 꽉차면 그때 식세기에 넣어줘요. 똑알맞게 모두 들어가고 적당합니다. 많지도 적지도 않게 설거지 잘되요.그리고 또 하나 스테인리스 제품을 넣어보면 고온살균하는 과정에서 스테인리스가 아닌 부분은 색이 뿌옇게 변합니다. 내가 사용하던 식기들이 스테인레스인지 아닌지 확인할수있는 기회!!사진에서 보이는게 국자 손잡이인데.. 20년넘게 사용한거라 좀 많이 낡았지만 창피함을 무릎쓰고 사진으로 남겨봅니다. ㅎㅎ손잡이가 스테인리스가 아니였더라고요. 20년만에 처음 알았습니다. 푸하하. 몇번 사용해보시면 그릇의 적당량을 알수 있어요. 사용은 직관적이라 따로 설명도 필요없을 정도고요. 살균세척도 좋지만 일단 허리 아픈분들. 가만히 서서 설거지하면 허리가 더 아작남니다. 빠르게 설치하시는거 강추합니다. 저도 진작 살걸 후회 많이 하고 있어요. 지금이라도 사용하는것에 스스로 칭찬 중입니다

Sentence (English): I bought this to replace an earlier LG dishwasher that I generally liked from a durability standpoint, but which had a major pump/motor issue after only about 3.5 years.
Comments (English): [ Lacks useful features - feels flimsy ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace an earlier LG dishwasher that I generally liked from a usability standpoint, but which had a major pump/motor issue after only about 3.5 years. The replacement pump/motor assembly was so expensive that repairing the machine made little economic sense — the part alone was a large percentage of the cost of an entire new dishwasher, and cost more than the original appliance once labor was included. That is disappointing and wasteful for an appliance that should last much longer.Unfortunately, the new model feels like a step backward in several day-to-day ways.Compared with my prior LG, this dishwasher has fewer built-in programs. There is no dedicated Delicate cycle on the control panel, only a downloadable option through the app, and there is no Energy Saver-type setting, which I used frequently for items where I did not want excessive heat. The manual confirms that downloadable cycles are handled through the LG ThinQ app and that only one downloaded cycle can be stored on the machine at a time.The racks are also disappointing. They feel flimsier than the prior model, and the tine layout does not hold dishes as securely. Plates and bowls fall over more easily and do not stand upright as naturally. The racks are also harder to slide in and out smoothly, which makes the machine feel cheaper in daily use.The dishwasher does have more new features — steam, auto-open drying, app connectivity, etc. — but I am not convinced those make it a better appliance. In fact, after my last LG failed because of a costly pump/motor issue, I worry that the added complexity may simply create more things that can break over time.The tub also feels slightly smaller or less usable in practice, even though the exterior size is standard. Between the rack layout and the way dishes fit, I do not feel like I can load as much as efficiently as I could in my prior LG.Overall, I'm disappointed. It may clean fine, and the specs look good on paper, but the day-to-day usability feels worse than the older model it replaced. Given the expensive failure of my previous LG after only 3.5 years, I expected the new one to feel like an improvement. Instead, it feels like a cost-reduced product with more features but less practical utility.

Comments (English): [ Disappointed — Abnormal Noise on Brand New Unit, N ] || ---------------- || I purchased the KitchenAid KDTS464SPS from Costco and started having issues within the first two weeks.During wash cycles, the dishwasher makes a repeating high‑pitched noise. It happens every few minutes, lasts about 1–2 minutes, and is consistent across cycles. I was told by the technician this is not a feature of this model, but it's hard to believe such a basic feature is missing on a new dishwasher.Overall, this does not seem like normal operation for a new unit. I am working with Costco toward a resolution and would expect replacement rather than ongoing service attempts.

Would not recommend unless you enjoy hand washing dishes and practicing patience with customer service representatives reading scripts.

Sentence (English): The sink counter where the dishwasher is located was 90cm wide, and I was informed that the existing sink needed to be removed and a new cabinet custom-built.
Comments (English): [ The installation costs were substantial, increasing the overall cost. ] || ---------------- || The sink counter where the dishwasher is located was 90cm wide, and I was informed that the existing sink needed to be removed and a new cabinet custom-built. Since this process involved building a cabinet for the 60cm width of the dishwasher and the remaining 30cm, as well as fabricating cabinet doors, the estimate came to 200,000 won. Additionally, because the house is 10 years old, drain cleaning was recommended but was explained as essential (assuming debris in the pipes could prevent the dishwasher from draining, causing backflow and potentially damaging the dishwasher). Given this explanation, how could I possibly refuse? So, I ended up spending another 160,000 won, bringing the total to 360,000 won. Furthermore, two separate appointments were required—one day for the construction estimate and one day for the installation—and the installation itself took two hours. If I had known about this explanation beforehand, I would have given it some thought. It is regrettable.
Comments (Original): [ 설치비가 만만치않게 들어서 비용이 늘어남 ] || ---------------- || 식세기 위치 싱크대 크기는 가로 90 이었고, 기존 싱크대를 들어내고 새 장을 짜야한다고 안내받았습니다. 그 과정에서 식세기 가로 60, 나머지 30cm에 대한 장을 짜고, 싱크대문도 제작해야하니 20만원이 견적나왔고요, 추가로 10년 된 집이니 하수구 청소도 권장이라고 하지만 필수라는 식의 설명 (식세기 배수하는데 배관 내 찌꺼기들로 내려가지 못하, 역류할 수 있고, 그로 인해 식세기 고장날 수 있다 ) 을 들으니 어떻게 안할 수 있겠습니까? 그래서 다시 16만원 총 36만원 들었습니다. 게다가 공사견적 1일, 설치 1일 이렇게 두번의 예약조율이 필요했고, 설치당일 2시간 걸렸습니다. 식세기 설치시 이런 설명은 미리 알았다면 고민해봤을텐데요. 아쉽습니다.

Sentence (English): The technician installed it diligently and meticulously, but I was disappointed because the extra charges were too high.
Comments (English): [ I haven't used it yet, but the product looks good. ] || ---------------- || The technician installed it diligently and meticulously, but I was disappointed because the extra charges were too high. The product itself seems fine, but the additional installation fees just made me feel like I was being ripped off. The extra costs were for reinforcing the sink countertop (using wooden boards and screwing in a few screws), adding a finishing layer since the baseboard was 12 cm high, and removing the channel panel right under the countertop when taking out the cabinet (a simple task of unscrewing screws). However, when he arrived on-site, he said he would charge 70,000 won more than the price quoted over the phone the day before. Sentence (English): Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful.
Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Sentence (English): Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing.
Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Sentence (English): After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date.
Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Sentence (English): Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed.
Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Sentence (English): I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible.
Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.
