Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Sentence (English): Maintenance Costs and User Review.
Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

Sentence (English): Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home.
Comments (English): [ The groom's dream, the dishwasher that improved our marital relationship ] || ---------------- || After getting married, washing dishes was the only task my husband was responsible for. He hated doing the dishes after dinner, so he would pile them up to do in the morning, which led to a lot of bickering. I am the type to wash dishes immediately after eating, but he wouldn't let me do them because he insisted it was his responsibility. Then, when I tried to make a fried egg in the morning, he would find there was no pan available, so I had to clean the greasy pan myself, which was quite stressful. Anyway, that is why my husband was determined to install a dishwasher before we had our baby. Initially, we called a technician to install an LG dishwasher, but he told us that since our apartment already had a food waste disposer connected to the sink, LG couldn't install it due to backflow or other issues if something else was installed in the plumbing. So, we contacted Samsung and the existing food waste disposer company to verify the details, and we safely ordered from Coupang, which offers a refund if installation is not possible. - A Touching Furniture Refurbishment Company. After ordering the dishwasher, you receive a message via KakaoTalk on the same day asking if the installation technician can visit on the scheduled date. Before the appliance installation team arrives, a technician who will build the cabinet visits first to confirm whether the dishwasher can be installed. However, besides the issue of the food waste disposer being installed in the plumbing, the pipe length itself was much shorter than the standard, making it difficult to install a dishwasher. I was truly touched by how you went out of your way to find a way to make installation possible. It might sound a bit harsh to say this, but the LG technician who came last time just said installation wasn't possible and left to avoid taking responsibility if any problems arose, so the difference was striking. I am truly grateful to Mr. Kim *-hyun, the technician from our furniture renovation partner. Thanks to you, the base cabinet was removed cleanly to fit the dimensions, and the appliance installation team that came afterward consisted of two people who completed the installation in a flash within 30 minutes. There were no additional costs for the appliance installation; the furniture renovation alone cost 60,000 won in total: 30,000 won for cutting the baseboard and 30,000 won for cutting through the furniture inside the pipe area to install parts due to the short pipe. This was even cheaper than the quote LG originally gave me. - Color: Cotta White I really agonized over the color when ordering. I debated whether to go with a clean white or Cotta White because my kitchen base cabinets have a slight gray tone. However, Cotta White looks much more luxurious and matches beautifully than I expected. The design seems slightly different from the white version in the top section, but I like that the door opens automatically just by pressing it down, without having to pull it. If your kitchen has a touch of gray like ours, I recommend Cotta White. - Maintenance Costs and User Review. I tend to be very picky about my spending, so before buying the dishwasher, I was extremely concerned about things like whether my back would hurt from constantly loading and unloading dishes, whether the cost of water and detergent would be higher, and whether it was right to run the dishwasher for an hour when we are currently a two-person household and don't have that much to wash. However, after actually using it, I found that using detergents like the Tamsa tablets sold on Coupang costs only a few tens of won per cycle. If I just roughly put in what I had for dinner and run it, it washes everything perfectly clean, and when it finishes, the door opens automatically to let the water dry. Above all, my husband still finds it fun to put dishes in and take them out, so he does it all himself. Seeing him so happy as the dishes pile up has brought peace to our home. I wish I had bought it sooner. I heard that reinstallation costs tens of thousands of won, so I'm not sure if we'll take the dishwasher with us when we move, but regardless, I think we will use it well and be very satisfied as long as we live in this house, so I think it is definitely worth the price.

I purchased this after much deliberation, wondering if I could install it by wrapping the hose around the gas or water purifier hole since it said the water supply hose could reach up to 5m. The technician came to inspect it and found that the gas hole location was over 5m long, so it didn't seem like it would work. Although technically it cannot be installed without drilling, he was able to install it successfully without drilling because there was a gap in the baseboard! (It really depends on the technician, so it might vary from house to house). Anyway, if you are hesitant like me, free returns are available if installation fails, so I recommend discussing it with the technician! The storage space is more generous than I expected. After installation, the technician told me to use half a bottle of Frosh detergent, but since there was some powder left over, I did some research and found that many people use half a bottle for the 12-place setting. So, I used a quarter of a bottle, and surprisingly, there were no water stains, and it came out clean! My usual 20-minute dishwashing time has been reduced to 5 minutes, which has really improved my quality of life! I am extremely satisfied.

Sentence (English): Reason for Purchase: Since washing dishes after meals is always a hassle, I did a lot of research and watched many videos on dishwashers.
Comments (English): Reason for Purchase: Since washing dishes after meals is always a hassle, I did a lot of research and watched many videos on dishwashers. I was debating between Samsung and My Dear products, but because My Dear had more of the features I wanted, I purchased the My Dear Automatic Door Opening UV Lamp Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity), White, MDWMT0601W-WINE-KR, with on-site installation.  Excellent drying power of the automatic door opening system: - Once the washing and high-temperature rinsing processes are complete, the door automatically opens to release internal steam and moisture. This prevents odors and water stains caused by water pooling inside, promotes natural drying to save energy, and maximizes drying efficiency.  Powerful sterilization management via UV lamp: - It is equipped with an internal UV lamp function. It provides 99.9% final sterilization of bacteria and viruses that may remain after washing, allowing you to safely store baby bottles, tableware, and tumblers. It is also useful as a substitute for a dish storage cabinet.  3-Stage Spray and Powerful Washing System: - It features a 3-stage washing system that sprays powerful water jets from the top, middle, and bottom. Despite being a compact countertop model, cleaning water reaches every nook and cranny without any blind spots, cleanly removing even the distinctive Korean-style burnt-on rice and grease stains. Space-efficient ultra-slim white design. - Size was the most important factor when purchasing the product. Thanks to a mounting width design that is slimmer than competitors' products, it was a perfect fit for my home, where the countertop space was limited. On-site installation. - I selected the professional on-site installation option, so a plumbing expert came. Since my house already had a water purifier line, they installed it directly there. They used the existing line but didn't even check for any hose issues; they just plugged it in and left. Later, when I saw the floor was soaking wet, I realized the hose had slightly burst. I was debating between Samsung and My Dear products, but because My Dear had more of the features I wanted, I purchased the My Dear Automatic Door Opening UV Lamp Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity), White, MDWMT0601W-WINE-KR, with on-site installation.  Excellent drying power of the automatic door opening system: - Once the washing and high-temperature rinsing processes are complete, the door automatically opens to release internal steam and moisture. This prevents odors and water stains caused by water pooling inside, promotes natural drying to save energy, and maximizes drying efficiency.  Powerful sterilization management via UV lamp: - It is equipped with an internal UV lamp function. It provides 99.9% final sterilization of bacteria and viruses that may remain after washing, allowing you to safely store baby bottles, tableware, and tumblers. It is also useful as a substitute for a dish storage cabinet.  3-Stage Spray and Powerful Washing System: - It features a 3-stage washing system that sprays powerful water jets from the top, middle, and bottom. Despite being a compact countertop model, cleaning water reaches every nook and cranny without any blind spots, cleanly removing even the distinctive Korean-style burnt-on rice and grease stains. Space-efficient ultra-slim white design. - Size was the most important factor when purchasing the product. Thanks to a mounting width design that is slimmer than competitors' products, it was a perfect fit for my home, where the countertop space was limited. On-site installation. - I selected the professional on-site installation option, so a plumbing expert came. Since my house already had a water purifier line, they installed it directly there. They used the existing line but didn't even check for any hose issues; they just plugged it in and left. Later, when I saw the floor was soaking wet, I realized the hose had slightly burst. It was like a flooded water park opening. I contacted Coupang and got a response saying to wait because it was the weekend? /. They claim there is no risk of leaks if a professional does it? It varies from technician to technician. In the end, I did it myself? I brought pliers, removed the front part, and inserted it to fix it.

Yeah, says the repair man these "new Dishwashers don't get as hot on the drying cycles" Well, then you suck at Whirlpool for going backwards instead of improving forward. Sentence (English): This product truly cuts dishwashing time in half.
Comments (English): [ Mini dishwasher that drastically reduces dishwashing stress ] || ---------------- || This product truly cuts dishwashing time in half. I didn't expect much because of its small size, but the cleaning power is better than I thought, so I use it almost every day now. Design. As expected from Samsung Electronics Bespoke, the design is really sleek. Even when placed on a corner of the kitchen, it feels more like a home decor appliance than a household appliance. It matched my white-toned kitchen particularly well. Since it is a 6-place setting, it isn't bulky, and it fits well in a studio apartment or a newlywed home kitchen. It is deeper than I expected, so pots and pans fit inside to some extent. The front door opens smoothly, and the control buttons are intuitive, so it wasn't difficult to use even for a first-timer. Performance. What I was most satisfied with about this product was that it cleans much better than I expected. Greasy dishes and soup stains were removed quite cleanly with the high-temperature wash. I was particularly satisfied that there was almost no lingering musty smell inside the cups. The automatic door opening feature was also quite convenient. Since the door opens automatically after the wash is finished, internal moisture escapes quickly, leaving fewer water stains or odors. The noise level isn't completely silent, but it wasn't too bothersome even when running at night. It feels like a washing machine running, so once you get used to it, it becomes a level that doesn't bother you. However, if you put items in with too much leftover food, residue was occasionally left behind. So, I found that rinsing large food items once before putting them in resulted in a much cleaner wash. Value for money. At first, I felt the price was a bit high, but after using it myself, I felt it was well worth the cost. In particular, the reduction in dishwashing stress is more significant than I expected. It feels like I'm saving 20 to 30 minutes a day, so I am very satisfied. Electricity and water usage were less of a burden than I thought, and it felt like I used less water than when washing dishes by hand. It seems like a quite efficient product for households of 1 to 3 people. Areas for improvement. Since it is a 6-place setting model, it is a bit inconvenient to put multiple large pots or pans in at once. Also, since proper arrangement of dishes is necessary for good cleaning efficiency, it required a bit of a knack for loading them at first. The drying performance is decent, but water droplets sometimes remained on plastic containers. This felt similar to any dishwasher, though. Sentence (English): First off, I was satisfied with everything regarding product delivery and the purchase.
Comments (English): First off, I was satisfied with everything regarding product delivery and the purchase. However, having the installation technician and the person doing the cabinet work for the dishwasher as separate entities was extremely inconvenient. It seems they don't communicate with each other. There was a lot of confusion; the installation technician said they didn't have extension cables and had to travel to another area to come back, causing a delay of about 4 hours. The cabinet worker didn't even know the dimensions of the product to be installed. It got to the point where I even asked both technicians if they were actually Samsung employees. As someone who uses only Samsung products for TVs, wash towers, projectors, and ceiling air conditioners, it was quite a shock. They seemed to lack any professionalism regarding their jobs. In the end, both of them worked hard and resolved the issue well. Also, I wonder if I missed something, but most dishwashers are placed in similar locations, right? However, for installations under induction cooktops or gas stoves, it would be helpful if you could announce in the sales post beforehand that people need to factor in a minimum budget of a certain amount. I made up my mind to have it installed, took time off work, and cleared my schedule so the technician could come, but... They said the induction cooktop can't be used until the frame construction is done separately because there isn't enough space. On top of that, they told me I have to find and arrange for the height adjustment work for the frame separately. Do you think I wouldn't be furious? Just thinking about it again makes me so angry. With other appliances, they were unnecessarily kind and I was satisfied, but regarding this dishwasher installation, they were worse than a small to medium-sized company.

There was a lot of confusion; the installation technician said they didn't have extension cables and had to travel to another area to come back, causing a delay of about 4 hours. The cabinet worker didn't even know the dimensions of the product to be installed. It got to the point where I even asked both technicians if they were actually Samsung employees. As someone who uses only Samsung products for TVs, wash towers, projectors, and ceiling air conditioners, it was quite a shock. They seemed to lack any professionalism regarding their jobs. In the end, both of them worked hard and resolved the issue well. Also, I wonder if I missed something, but most dishwashers are placed in similar locations, right? However, for installations under induction cooktops or gas stoves, it would be helpful if you could announce in the sales post beforehand that people need to factor in a minimum budget of a certain amount. I made up my mind to have it installed, took time off work, and cleared my schedule so the technician could come, but... They said the induction cooktop can't be used until the frame construction is done separately because there isn't enough space. On top of that, they told me I have to find and arrange for the height adjustment work for the frame separately. Do you think I wouldn't be furious? Just thinking about it again makes me so angry. With other appliances, they were unnecessarily kind and I was satisfied, but regarding this dishwasher installation, they were worse than a small to medium-sized company.

Sentence (English): If I could give negative stars I would.
Comments (English): [ Pay for stuff and get nothing but frustration.  ] || ---------------- || If I could give negative stars I would. Absolute frustrating nightmare. Getting older, used to build houses many years ago, worked my way up from sweeping floors to being a superintendent of a subdivision, so about 50 homes a year for ten years. Point is I know what I am talking about. Read the contract when purchasing this item. Indications in the contract described a delivery service, a “suitability verification”, and a separate installation service. As typical for this area they are "all in one" and the one thing they love to do is come up with a reason NOT to do a job. Sure they will drop the thing off the truck, maybe even run it into your house. Actually installing it? That is where their true nature shines through, rather than get to work figuring out how to get the job done, they put on their “suitability verification” hats on and point out “Oh, there is no ground fault outlet under your sink. We cannot install.” Me “What about a direct wire option? ” (Delivery guy now has his installer hat on) Installer “We cannot do that, unit only comes with a wall plug” Actually the installation manual describes a direct wire option but the delivery guys are not “electricians”. I offered to move the wire for them. So the installation technician you are getting does not have any sophistication or training other than to find a way around actually installing the product. They even wanted to have the shutoff valve replaced under the sink cause it was dripping when I turned it off to remove the previous dishwasher. Of course these “workers” have a camera and can document how they were unable to install due to power and plumbing deficiency. Never mind the fact that a dishwasher functioned in that space for ten years prior to the delivery, this drawer dishwasher is different, essentially a box about 3-4 inches less depth than your 24” counter top. Suggest you find and review the installation manual as it has details about the very specific requirements necessary for success. GE even has an installation video, funny how Costco failed to include that link or the actual requirements as presented by their “delivery crew”. Then to just add to the frustration the installation manual has the obscure one liner about putting “three cups of water” in the drawers and running a rinse cycle to confirm operation. After all those many years ago… common for the new homeowners to contact me cause the “Dishwasher was not working! ” Tell them to dump a large pot of water into the bottom of the dishwasher, that it was bit like priming a pump… still the same except now we have app that cannot be concise or correct as to what ails the dishwasher but it sure can try to sell you some detergent … A1 “No water fault”… well the supply is hooked up and turned on, what could be the problem? So IMHO Costco should line item out the delivery and installation fees rather than the all inclusive price. Feel like I have been scammed by their delivery contractor…

Point is I know what I am talking about. Read the contract when purchasing this item. Indications in the contract described a delivery service, a “suitability verification”, and a separate installation service. As typical for this area they are 'all in one' and the one thing they love to do is come up with a reason NOT to do a job. Sure they will drop the thing off the truck, maybe even run it into your house. Actually installing it? That is where their true nature shines through, rather than get to work figuring out how to get the job done, they put on their “suitability verification” hats on and point out “Oh, there is no ground fault outlet under your sink. We cannot install.” Me “What about a direct wire option?” (Delivery guy now has his installer hat on) Installer “We cannot do that, unit only comes with a wall plug” Actually the installation manual describes a direct wire option but the delivery guys are not “electricians”. I offered to move the wire for them... So the installation technician you are getting does not have any sophistication or training other than to find a way around actually installing the product. They even wanted to have the shutoff valve replaced under the sink cause it was dripping when I turned it off to remove the previous dishwasher. Of course these “workers” have a camera and can document how they were unable to install due to power and plumbing deficiency. Never mind the fact that a dishwasher functioned in that space for ten years prior to the delivery, this drawer dishwasher is different, essentially a box about 3-4 inches less depth than your 24” counter top. Suggest you find and review the installation manual as it has details about the very specific requirements necessary for success. GE even has an installation video, funny how Costco failed to include that link or the actual requirements as presented by their “delivery crew”. Then to just add to the frustration the installation manual has the obscure one liner about putting “three cups of water” in the drawers and running a rinse cycle to confirm operation. After all those many years ago… common for the new homeowners to contact me cause the “Dishwasher was not working!” Tell them to dump a large pot of water into the bottom of the dishwasher, that it was bit like priming a pump… still the same except now we have app that cannot be concise or correct as to what ails the dishwasher but it sure can try to sell you some detergent  … A1 “No water fault”… well the supply is hooked up and turned on, what could be the problem? So IMHO Costco should line item out the delivery and installation fees rather than the all inclusive price. Feel like I have been scammed by their delivery contractor…

Getting older, used to build houses many years ago, worked my way up from sweeping floors to being a superintendent of a subdivision, so about 50 homes a year for ten years. Point is I know what I am talking about. Read the contract when purchasing this item. Indications in the contract described a delivery service, a “suitability verification”, and a separate installation service. As typical for this area they are "all in one" and the one thing they love to do is come up with a reason NOT to do a job. Sure they will drop the thing off the truck, maybe even run it into your house. Actually installing it? That is where their true nature shines through, rather than get to work figuring out how to get the job done, they put on their “suitability verification” hats on and point out “Oh, there is no ground fault outlet under your sink. We cannot install.” Me “What about a direct wire option? ” (Delivery guy now has his installer hat on) Installer “We cannot do that, unit only comes with a wall plug” Actually the installation manual describes a direct wire option but the delivery guys are not “electricians”. I offered to move the wire for them. So the installation technician you are getting does not have any sophistication or training other than to find a way around actually installing the product. They even wanted to have the shutoff valve replaced under the sink cause it was dripping when I turned it off to remove the previous dishwasher. Of course these “workers” have a camera and can document how they were unable to install due to power and plumbing deficiency. Never mind the fact that a dishwasher functioned in that space for ten years prior to the delivery, this drawer dishwasher is different, essentially a box about 3-4 inches less depth than your 24” counter top. Suggest you find and review the installation manual as it has details about the very specific requirements necessary for success. GE even has an installation video, funny how Costco failed to include that link or the actual requirements as presented by their “delivery crew”. Then to just add to the frustration the installation manual has the obscure one liner about putting “three cups of water” in the drawers and running a rinse cycle to confirm operation. After all those many years ago… common for the new homeowners to contact me cause the “Dishwasher was not working! ” Tell them to dump a large pot of water into the bottom of the dishwasher, that it was bit like priming a pump… still the same except now we have app that cannot be concise or correct as to what ails the dishwasher but it sure can try to sell you some detergent … A1 “No water fault”… well the supply is hooked up and turned on, what could be the problem? So IMHO Costco should line item out the delivery and installation fees rather than the all inclusive price. Feel like I have been scammed by their delivery contractor…

Sentence (English): Bought the Bosch Benchmark unit late November 2025; unit was installed in December 2025.
Comments (English): [ 3 repairs in 6 months ] || ---------------- || Bought the Bosch Benchmark unit late November 2025; unit was installed in December 2025. From the moment we received the unit we noticed that there was too much water left over on cups and Tupperware even after using the CrystalDry cycle. At first we thought we are not using the machine properly, so read through manual, adjusted racks, how we load, different cycles, etc. Eventually in early February 2026 the dishwasher stopped operating with error number: E21-30.Scheduled repair through Bosch website, technician diagnosed the issue to be related to the heating components and replaced a number of parts. Unit worked fine until April 2026, when it went from whisper quiet to buzzing during heating cycles. Another repair scheduled through Bosch website, another technician and a new problem where the fan was not functioning to spec. Technician replaced it, machine worked fine for a few weeks until a similar buzzing sound appeared at the drying cycle at the end. A third repair scheduled through Bosch in May, technician was just in our house today and said that indeed something is not right and that the fan will need to be replaced. Part ordered and repair incoming. At this point starting to look at how Bosch and Costco can replace the unit, this is completely unacceptable for a unit that costs over $1700 and its 6 months old. Bosch has only 1 year of full labor and parts coverage and at this rate of issues this unit will be too expensive to continue to repair once warranty expires.

The Fisher Paykel had less complicated controls, but GE Profile's controls are not too complex once I got used to them. They are way more electronic of course. I did like FP's controls being on top of the drawers rather than on the front. The GE drawers are similarly & nicely set up for dishes. However, our 10.75 inch plates won't fit in the bottom drawer. I didn't care much for having to download the GE App in order to change some settings, but that's the way most things are nowadays. Overall, so far I am happy with the new GE Profile and was happy to find it available to consumers. There's not a ton of drawer dishwashers out there & I cannot understand why.
